findings.reason: a hold keyed to an identifier no reader can resolve is unfalsifiable, so a later worker cannot know when the hold lifts and may either ignore it or wait forever.
findings.text: followup f-otmp-one-figure-follow-ons says "Hold anything that writes reckon/crew/dispatch.py or reckon/cli.py until reckon-9d's module split lands", but reckon-9d resolves to no plan, node or document (the module-split plan is every-module-fits-a-worker-window; reckon-9d appears nowhere else in the repository)

findings.reason: the plan carries an open question it has already answered and a false statement of present behaviour, so a later worker reading §6's followups acts on a settled question and a stale premise.
findings.text: open followup f-otmp-review-follow-ons closes "Lead decision still open: may Jev override an explicit --local ... Until that is answered, Jev only shadows in practice", yet decisions local-is-authoritative (2026-10-06) and picker-chooses-the-lane (2026-10-07) answer exactly that question (a named lane stays authoritative; the picker routes only dispatches that name none) and §1 line 44 records the narrowing, while routing.picker: route has been the default since 2026-10-03

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the newly added followup f-otmp-one-figure-follow-ons keys its hold instruction to an identifier, reckon-9d, that resolves to no plan, node or document anywhere in the repository.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §6's done-when is a measurable publication of named measures (success rate, spend, refused/logged-out-model count, latency, fallback rate, confidence), and its otherwise-branch (the plan records the negative result rather than switching) is the declared control against a switch that cannot fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate and landing anchors point under docs/evidence/ (docs/evidence/archive/one-typesafe-model-picker-landed.html#s6, docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/*) or the durable crew reports directory; the archive anchors and docs/state/reckon/runs/ all exist on disk.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the followup and decisions name mechanisms and resolvable test/module symbols (dispatch_picker_selection, tests/test_member_friction.py::test_unnamed_dispatch_is_admitted_while_a_review_worker_is_alive, reckon/crew/dispatch.py).
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the open followup f-otmp-review-follow-ons still states a lead question is open and that Jev only shadows, which the plan's own later decisions and the 2026-10-03 switch contradict.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 carries one goal (prototype, shadow and dogfood the router); each landed section §2–§5 and §7–§11 records one deliverable in its landed-summary.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — plan-after (the-local-lane-is-the-default), plan-informs (a-window-paces-the-lane, the-local-lane-is-the-default, advise-the-lane-never-force-it) and both gates resolve to nodes/plans that exist; the informs list matches the three plans §1 line 45 says this one absorbs, so the prior missing-informs finding is answered.
